title: FlowBound autoscale advisor and utilization-delta exporter
author: Jordan Lee
release_notes: Introduces FlowBound autoscale advisor (suggests reservation & smoothing parameters) and a utilization-delta telemetry exporter. Adds console API for reservation suggestions. No breaking API changes. Backwards compatible with existing autoscaler configs.
description:
Context: Dedicated pools occasionally suffer short-lived micro-bursts that cause downstream queueing and SLA slippage even when long-term utilization looks healthy. Existing autoscaler reacts to windowed percentiles which leads to oscillation or delayed capacity adjustments for tenants with spiky traffic. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: 1) FlowBound — a delta-aware autoscale advisor that computes per-tenant flow bounds (request-rate + token-rate jitter) and recommends conservative reservation delta adjustments and smoothing parameters, and 2) utilization-delta exporter — a telemetry adapter that emits compact histograms and trend tags for per-tenant utilization deltas so fleet-level controllers and dashboards can reason about short-timescale volatility.

Motivation: Reduce oscillation and missed short SLOs by making autoscaling decisions informed by short-horizon rate deltas and by surfacing volatility metrics to ops and ML-based advisors.

Changeset summary:
- pkg/autoscaler/flowbound_advisor.go: core algorithm (EMA of request rate, token-rate derivative, confidence bands, delta->reservation suggestion mapper).
- telemetry/exporters/util_delta_exporter.go: exports delta histograms (1s/5s/30s buckets), streak detection tags and sample rate controls.
- cmd/console/api/reservation_suggestions.go: read-only API surface to fetch advisor suggestions for a tenant (used by Console UI).
- internal/config/autoscale_profiles.yaml: new flowbound profile presets and default smoothing params.
- e2e/tests/autoscale_flowbound_test.go: synthetic surge harness + assertions on SLA and oscillation.
- docs/observability/flowbound.md: design notes, examples for interpreting metrics and recommended thresholds.
- proto/telemetry/v1/util_delta.proto: exporter schema and migration notes.
- CI updates: linter config for goimports and proto generation step.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc and benchmarks attached (docs/observability/flowbound.md)
- [x] Unit tests for advisor math and boundary conditions
- [x] E2E synthetic harness demonstrating reduced oscillation under 5m/95th SLO
- [x] Telemetry schema reviewed for cardinality cost
- [x] Console API read-only and behind feature flag

Rollout plan: feature gated behind autoscale.flowbound.enabled (false by default). We plan a staged rollout: local integration -> small Dedicated pool rollout (10 customers) -> fleet-wide opt-in. If customers observe regressions they can set autoscale.flowbound.enabled=false or adjust autoscale.profiles.flowbound.smoothing_ms.

Backwards compatibility: Advisor only suggests reservation deltas; it does not change existing reservation state until an operator or automated policy (separate PR) applies suggestions. Telemetry is additive.

Commits (high-level):
- feat(autoscaler): add flowbound advisor implementation
- feat(telemetry): util-delta exporter + proto
- feat(console): reservation suggestions endpoint
- test(e2e): synthetic surge harness + assertions
- fix(lint): proto gen and imports

Adjusted heuristics:
- Added a 'confidence_band' parameter for tuning conservativeness; default tuned to avoid false-positive reserve growth in noisy workloads.
- Default smoothing windows increased to reduce churn for long-lived tenants.

Review summary (selected conversation threads):
- Maya: "Can we expose the advisor's confidence band and smoothing parameters in the Console UI? Operators will want to tune them per-customer." — Jordan: "Added console knobs as internal settings behind the same feature flag; UI follow-up planned in a small separate PR to keep this change reviewable."
- Carlos: "Edge-case: extremely low qps tenants get noisy deltas; is there a floor?" — Jordan: "Advisor ignores tenants with sustained <0.1 rps and returns no suggestion (see flowbound_advisor_test {})."
- Priya: "Add more logging around sample drops and proto failures; we saw flakiness in the exporter e2e." — Jordan: "Added structured logs and retry for transient proto push failures. CI showed flake which I fixed in the follow-up commit."

CI history:
- Initial run: failed (golangci-lint: goimports issues, protogen mismatch).
- Second run: green after proto regen and imports fixes.
- Flaky e2e: failed once in 10 runs due to test harness timing; re-ran and passed.

Observability & dashboards:
- New Grafana panels: per-tenant util_delta_95/50/10 series, flowbound_suggestion_rate, flowbound_recommendations_count.
- Alert: util_delta_95 > 0.35 for 30s in 3 distinct tenants triggers an SRE runbook recommending temporary warm pool expansion.

Performance & cost notes:
- Exporter sample rate default is 1:10 to keep cardinality low; can be increased for specific tenants via sampling rules.
- Minimal CPU overhead observed in 10-customer pilot <3% on autoscaler control-plane.

Testing & validation:
- Unit tests for numerical stability around low-qps and bursty patterns.
- E2E shows average 18% reduction in 95th tail queueing latency for the pilot tenants under synthetic microbursts.
- Load tests included to validate exporter throughput at 5k tps across the fleet.

Follow-ups (tracked separately):
- ENG-5491 automated applier to convert suggestions into recommended reservation changes with safety gates.
- UI follow-up to surface tuning knobs and rollouts.

Merge outcome: squashed and merged to main by Jordan Lee after approvals from Maya and Carlos.

Notes on uniqueness: algorithm emphasizes delta-based trimming and conservative reservation growth; differs from percentile/reservoir approaches by exposing volatility telemetry and suggestion primitives rather than directly mutating reservation state.
notes_for_ops: Feature disabled by default. To enable for a region set autoscale.flowbound.enabled=true in cluster config and optionally tune autoscale.profiles.flowbound.smoothing_ms and confidence_band. Recommended pilot on a small set of tenants; monitor flowbound_recommendations_count and util_delta_95 dashboards.
related_issues: ENG-5421: reduce autoscale oscillation for microbursts
ENG-5490: surface short-horizon volatility to ops
security_considerations: Telemetry schema kept low-cardinality; sensitive tenant identifiers hashed before export. No secret material exposed. Export payload rate-limited and sampled to avoid exfiltration risk.
migration_instructions: Proto change is additive. Run proto generation step (ci/jenkinsfile.proto-gen) to regenerate stubs. Console API is behind feature-flag; no immediate migration required.
